عَقِيدٌ i. q. ↓ مُعَاقِدٌ , (S, O, K,) One who unites,
or joins, in a contract, a compact, a covenant, an agreement, a league, a treaty, or an engagement: (K, TA:) a confederate. (TA.) One says, هُوَ عَقِيدُ الكَرَمِ and اللُّؤْمِ [He is bound by nature to generosity and to meanness]: (S, O, K:) the former is said of him who is by nature generous; and the latter, of him who is by nature mean. (TK.) ―
-b2- Also, (S, M, A, O,) and ↓ مُعْقَدٌ , (M,) and ↓ مُعَقَّدٌ , (A,) applied to rob, (S, M, A,) and honey, (M, A, O,) and the like, (S, M, A,) Thick, or thickened, or inspissated. (S, M, A, O. *)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
